instruction: Convert the video's audio to OGG Vorbis and store it as 'Baby Justin Bieber.ogg' on your desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires exporting audio from MP4 video to OGG Vorbis format using VLC. Evaluator checks: (1) File created on Desktop (35%), (2) Filename is 'Baby Justin Bieber.ogg' (30%), (3) MIME type contains 'ogg' (audio/ogg, audio/x-vorbis+ogg, or application/ogg) (20%), (4) File size > 80KB (15%). Format verification ensures actual OGG conversion occurred.
metadata.verification: Verified by checking file exists at /home/user/Desktop/Baby Justin Bieber.ogg, filename matches exactly, MIME type check confirms OGG format (checks for 'ogg' in MIME type), and file is at least 80KB to ensure non-empty conversion.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: File created (35%) + Correct filename (30%) + OGG format verified (20%) + Adequate size (15%) = 100%

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: All instruction requirements verified (file creation, exact filename, OGG format, non-empty conversion)
Correct getter logic: Extracts file info from exact path specified in instruction, uses reliable 'file --mime-type' for format verification
Correct metric logic: Progressive scoring with sensible weights, checks existence before other validations, MIME type check ensures actual conversion not just file rename
Correct data flow: Getter returns dict with exists/filename/is_ogg/size, metric accesses these fields correctly, no parameter handling errors
Semantically correct expected values: Filename matches instruction exactly, 80KB min size is reasonable for audio extraction from video
Robust implementation: Handles edge cases (missing file, MIME type errors) gracefully with try/except and early returns
No postconfig needed: File saved to disk is persistent state, no UI/dialog state dependencies
